_recipe.title: Product launch reel
_recipe.when: A new product, gadget, feature or app goes live and you want a punchy 9:16 announcement for Reels, Shorts and TikTok.
beats: Hook: time shock. The old way is struck out and the new way lands by ~2s.
Reveal: the name, then the one-line promise.
Features: three tiles, 1-3 words each. Only what the product really does.
Proof: one real number (beta result, speed, users) that counts up.
Why switch: the old way vs your product, two rows each, spoken in the same order.
Offer: launch discount or code with a deadline (the highlight box = urgency).
CTA: one action, where to do it, your handle.
copyTips: Replace every [CAPS] slot with the user's facts. Never invent the proof number, the price or the deadline: ask once, or delete that beat.
Digits on screen ("[2] HRS"), words in say ("two hours"). Keep say and show in the same order so each line appears as it is spoken.
Neon + snappy + fast suits tech, gadgets and apps. Beauty / D2C: --theme pop. Calm premium launch: --theme clean (or use launch-film-16x9).
Feature tiles take 1-3 words; put detail in a tile's "sub" or cut it.
No launch offer? Delete beat 6; the CTA's "Available now" carries the urgency.
